company_info.description: Yomeishu Seizo Co.,Ltd. produces and sells alcoholic beverages and food products in Japan and internationally. The company operates through the Yomeishu-Related Business and Kurasuwa-Related Business segments. It offers quasi-drugs, foodstuffs, alcohol, and foods with functional claims. The company sells, leases, manages, brokerages real estate properties; manages restaurants and shops; manufactures and sells alcoholic beverages; manufactures, sells, imports, and brokerages food products; outsources analysis and testing related to physical chemistry and pharmaceutical science, and related consulting services; and generates, supplies, and sells electricity through renewable energy, including solar energy, as well as provides business and consulting services related to environmental measurement certification. Yomeishu Seizo Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1923 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
